items.text: Matter can existin threebasic forms:asa solid,a liquid oragas.In thisphoto all threeare present,thoughwecanonly seethesolidiceberg andtheliquidocean.Fortunately theiceberg issurroundedbygas,themixtureofoxygenandnitrogenthatmakesupouratmosphere.Our atmosphere usuallycontainssomewaterin gas form,which wecannotsee.When gaseouswater in theatmospherecondensesinto tinywaterdropletswecanseetheseasclouds.
